components.note: Grain output of 1.43 trillion jin and real income growth of 5.0% were also met

footnote: Source: 2025 and 2026 Government Work Reports, NBS 2025 Statistical Communiqué (February 28, 2026)
notes: The 2025 targets, one by one. GDP grew 5% to ¥140.19 trillion. Cities added 12.67 million jobs, and surveyed unemployment averaged 5.2%. Grain output was 1.43 trillion jin, about 715 million tonnes. Energy use per unit of GDP fell 5.1%, beating the target of about 3%. Real per-capita disposable income grew 5.0%, matching GDP. The one clear miss was prices: the target was a rise of about 2%, and the statistics bureau's words were that consumer prices were flat for the year, while producer prices fell 2.6%. That is why this year's report says it wants to turn the overall price level positive (推动价格总水平由负转正).
